text: In Japan, you can rent a dad.
One company will send a stand-in father
for about a hundred and thirty dollars an hour.
Need wedding guests?
Twenty thousand yen each.
Extra if they sing.
More for a heartfelt speech.
One groom rented all thirty of his guests.
Messed up at work,
and your boss has to apologize with you?
You can rent the boss, too.
One founder said he'd been a girl's father for eight years.
She didn't know.
Luckily, rental husbands come with rules:
nothing past holding hands.
Unluckily, about a third of the women end up proposing.
Here's the thing.
Nobody's paying for the acting.
They're paying for someone who shows up,
listens, and knows their name.
Like a nightlight.
Nobody cares how it works.
They just don't want to be alone in the dark.
Even the founder says a service like this shouldn't need to exist.
Feeloy doesn't pretend to be anyone.
It just shows up,
listens, and remembers.
Your day, your people, the little things.
No booking required.
Search Feeloy on the App Store.
